sentence: Direct: Deepak said, "I work in the High Court computer cell."
correctAnswer: Deepak said that he worked in the High Court computer cell.

steps.step1_marker: Speaker & Listener Analysis: Reporting subject (speaker) Deepak (male singular) hai. Listener mention nahi hai.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb & Conjunction: Reporting verb 'said' past tense mein hai aur bina object ke hai, isliye 'said' retain rahega aur quotation marks hatakar conjunction 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Pronoun Reference Shift: 1st person pronoun 'I' Deepak (speaker) ke anusaar badal kar 'he' ban gaya.
steps.step4_inflection: Tense Backshift: Reporting verb past hone ke karan Simple Present verb 'work' backshift hokar Simple Past 'worked' ban gayi.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'Deepak said that he worked in the High Court computer cell.'

trapWarning: EXAM TRAP: Distractor options mein aksar 'Deepak said that I worked...' (pronoun change na karna) ya 'Deepak told that he worked...' (told bina object ke) diya jata hai. Dono eliminate karein.

sentence: Direct: The advocate said to the client, "You need to submit the original affidavit."
correctAnswer: The advocate told the client that he needed to submit the original affidavit.
tense: Reporting Verb Concord & 2nd Person Pronoun Shift

steps.step1_marker: Speaker & Listener Analysis: Speaker 'The advocate' hai aur listener 'the client' (singular) hai.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb & Conjunction: 'Said to + listener' transform hokar 'told the client' ban gaya, quotation marks hataye gaye aur conjunction 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Pronoun Reference Shift: 2nd person pronoun 'You' listener 'the client' ke anusaar 'he' (ya contextually 'she') ban gaya.
steps.step4_inflection: Tense Backshift: Simple Present verb 'need' backshift hokar Simple Past 'needed' ban gayi. Infinitive 'to submit' uninflected raha.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The advocate told the client that he needed to submit the original affidavit.'

trapWarning: FATAL 'TOLD TO' BLUNDER: Option mein 'The advocate told to the client...' likha ho toh turant eliminate karein. 'Told' ke baad 'to' lagana examination standard mein fatal error hai.

sentence: Direct: Neha said, "The technical assistants are installing the network firewall."
correctAnswer: Neha said that the technical assistants were installing the network firewall.

steps.step1_marker: Speaker & Subject Check: Speaker Neha hai. Quoted clause ka subject 'The technical assistants' (plural noun) hai.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb & Conjunction: Past reporting verb 'said' ke baad declarative conjunction 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Pronoun Inspection: Quoted clause mein 3rd person noun 'the technical assistants' hai jisme koi person change nahi hoga.
steps.step4_inflection: Tense Backshift: Present Continuous auxiliary 'are installing' plural subject ke anusaar Past Continuous 'were installing' mein convert ho gayi.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'Neha said that the technical assistants were installing the network firewall.'

trapWarning: AUXILIARY NUMBER ACCORD: Distractor options mein aksar 'was installing' likhkar subject-verb discord create kiya jata hai. Plural subject 'assistants' ke sath 'were installing' aayega.

sentence: Direct: The system officers said, "We have resolved the database deadlock."
correctAnswer: The system officers said that they had resolved the database deadlock.
tense: Present Perfect ➔ Past Perfect (Plural Pronoun Shift)

steps.step1_marker: Speaker & Listener Context: Speaker 'The system officers' (plural) hai. Listener unspecified hai.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb & Link: 'Said' retain raha aur subordinate clause ko connect karne ke liye 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Pronoun Reference Shift: 1st person plural pronoun 'We' officers (plural speaker) ke anusaar 'they' mein transform hua.
steps.step4_inflection: Tense Backshift: Present Perfect 'have resolved' past reporting verb ke karan Past Perfect 'had resolved' mein convert ho gaya.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The system officers said that they had resolved the database deadlock.'

trapWarning: PRONOUN PLURALITY TRAP: Distractor options mein aksar 'We' ko 'he' bana diya jata hai. Officers plural hain, isliye pronoun strictly 'they' hoga.

sentence: Direct: The registrar said, "The petitioner submitted the supplementary petition yesterday."
correctAnswer: The registrar said that the petitioner had submitted the supplementary petition the previous day.
tense: Simple Past ➔ Past Perfect & Adverbial Adjustment

steps.step1_marker: Speaker Context: Speaker 'The registrar' hai. Quoted sentence pehle se hi Simple Past ('submitted') mein hai.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb: Past verb 'said' ke baad conjunction 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Pronoun / Noun Check: 'The petitioner' 3rd person noun hai, koi change nahi.
steps.step4_inflection: Tense & Time Shift: Simple Past 'submitted' Past Perfect 'had submitted' ban gaya. Time adverbial 'yesterday' convert hokar 'the previous day' ban gaya.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The registrar said that the petitioner had submitted the supplementary petition the previous day.'

trapWarning: FAILURE TO BACKSHIFT SIMPLE PAST: Candidates aksar 'submitted' ko 'submitted' hi chhod dete hain aur 'yesterday' ko change nahi karte. Examination grammar mein Simple Past compulsory 'had + V3' banta hai.

sentence: Direct: She said, "The judicial clerks were verifying the certified copies."
correctAnswer: She said that the judicial clerks had been verifying the certified copies.
tense: Past Continuous ➔ Past Perfect Continuous Backshift

steps.step1_marker: Speaker Context: Speaker 'She' hai. Quoted sentence Past Continuous 'were verifying' mein hai.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb & Conjunction: 'Said' ke baad conjunction 'that' insert kiya gaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Subject Tracking: 'The judicial clerks' 3rd person plural noun hai, uninflected raha.
steps.step4_inflection: Tense Backshift: Past Continuous 'were verifying' standard narration rule ke anusaar Past Perfect Continuous 'had been verifying' mein convert ho gaya.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'She said that the judicial clerks had been verifying the certified copies.'

trapWarning: ASPECT CONFUSION: Distractor options mein aksar 'were verifying' ko Simple Past Continuous hi chhod diya jata hai ya 'had verified' bana diya jata hai. Continuous aspect retain hokar 'had been + V4' banta hai.

sentence: Direct: The judge said, "The division bench will announce the final order tomorrow."
correctAnswer: The judge said that the division bench would announce the final order the next day.

steps.step1_marker: Speaker Analysis: Speaker 'The judge' hai. Modal auxiliary 'will' aur time adverbial 'tomorrow' present hain.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb & Conjunction: Past verb 'said' ke baad conjunction 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Subject Tracking: 'The division bench' 3rd person subject hai.
steps.step4_inflection: Modal & Adverb Shift: Future modal 'will' past reporting verb ke under 'would' mein backshift hua (main verb 'announce' base form mein rahi). 'Tomorrow' shift hokar 'the next day' ban gaya.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The judge said that the division bench would announce the final order the next day.'

trapWarning: DOUBLE CHANGE CHECK: Is question mein do points check hote hain: (1) will ➔ would, aur (2) tomorrow ➔ the next day (ya the following day). Option mein agar 'tomorrow' unadjusted ho toh discard karein.

sentence: Direct: The clerk said to me, "I can inspect this server log right now."
correctAnswer: The clerk told me that he could inspect that server log right then.

steps.step1_marker: Speaker & Listener: Speaker 'The clerk' hai, listener 'me' hai.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb & Link: 'Said to me' convert hokar 'told me' bana, conjunction 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Pronoun Reference: 1st person 'I' clerk (speaker) ke anusaar 'he' ban gaya.
steps.step4_inflection: Modal & Adverbial Shifts: Modal 'can' ➔ 'could' mein badla. Demonstrative 'this' ➔ 'that' bana, aur time expression 'now' ➔ 'then' mein shift hua.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The clerk told me that he could inspect that server log right then.'

trapWarning: PROXIMITY SHIFT: Options mein agar 'this' ya 'now' ko unmodified chhod diya gaya ho, toh wo option eliminate ho jayega: this ➔ that, now ➔ then.

sentence: Direct: The physics professor said, "Light travels faster than sound."
correctAnswer: The physics professor said that light travels faster than sound.

steps.step1_marker: Clause Content Analysis: Quoted sentence 'Light travels faster than sound' ek scientifically established eternal universal truth hai.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb & Conjunction: Past reporting verb 'said' ke baad conjunction 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Subject & Pronouns: 'Light' universal scientific entity hai, no change.
steps.step4_inflection: Exception Rule Application: Reporting verb past hone ke bawajood scientific laws aur eternal truths ka tense backshift NAHI hota. Present Simple verb 'travels' uninflected Simple Present mein retain rahi.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The physics professor said that light travels faster than sound.'

trapWarning: CRITICAL UNIVERSAL TRUTH TRAP: Distractor options mein aksar 'light traveled faster than sound' diya jata hai. Scientific truth kabhi past nahi banti; 'travels' hi correct hai.

sentence: Direct: The geography teacher said to the students, "The Earth rotates from west to east."
correctAnswer: The geography teacher told the students that the Earth rotates from west to east.

steps.step1_marker: Speaker & Listener: Speaker 'The geography teacher' hai, listener 'the students' hai.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb: 'Said to the students' ➔ 'told the students' bana, conjunction 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Statement Evaluation: Statement 'The Earth rotates from west to east' permanent geographical fact hai.
steps.step4_inflection: Tense Invariance: Geographical fact hone ke karan verb 'rotates' freeze rehti hai; 'rotated' nahi banti.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The geography teacher told the students that the Earth rotates from west to east.'

trapWarning: MIXED SKILL TRAP: Yahan candidate ko do baatein ek sath verify karni hain: (1) said to ➔ told the students, aur (2) rotates freeze rahega (rotated nahi hoga).

sentence: Direct: The IT director says, "The cloud server is fully operational."
correctAnswer: The IT director says that the cloud server is fully operational.

steps.step1_marker: Reporting Verb Tense Check: Reporting verb 'says' Simple Present Tense mein hai (Past 'said' nahi hai).
steps.step2_time: Conjunction Insertion: 'Says' ke baad conjunction 'that' lagaya gaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Subject Inspection: 'The cloud server' 3rd person subject hai.
steps.step4_inflection: Zero Backshift Rule: Jab reporting verb Present ya Future tense mein ho, toh reported clause ke tense mein ZERO backshift hota hai. Auxiliary 'is' 'is' hi rahega.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The IT director says that the cloud server is fully operational.'

trapWarning: PRESENT VERB OVER-BACKSHIFT: Top exam trap! Candidates mechanical aadat ke karan 'is' ko 'was' kar dete hain. Reporting verb agar 'says' hai, toh tense bilkul change nahi hoga.

sentence: Direct: The Chief Justice will say, "The judiciary respects the constitutional mandate."
correctAnswer: The Chief Justice will say that the judiciary respects the constitutional mandate.
tense: Future Reporting Verb ('Will say') — Zero Backshift

steps.step1_marker: Reporting Verb Tense Check: Reporting verb 'will say' Future Tense mein hai.
steps.step2_time: Conjunction Link: 'Will say' ke baad conjunction 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Subject Tracking: 'The judiciary' 3rd person subject hai.
steps.step4_inflection: Future Verb Rule: Reporting verb future mein hone par reported speech ka tense freeze rehta hai. Verb 'respects' unchanged Simple Present mein retain rahi.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The Chief Justice will say that the judiciary respects the constitutional mandate.'

trapWarning: FUTURE REPORTING VERB: Distractor options mein 'respected' diya jata hai. Jab tak reporting verb past na ho, tab tak backshift strictly forbidden hai.

sentence: Direct: Suresh said to me, "She has misplaced her court access badge."
correctAnswer: Suresh told me that she had misplaced her court access badge.
tense: Third Person Pronoun Invariance & Present Perfect Backshift

steps.step1_marker: Speaker & Listener: Speaker Suresh hai, listener 'me' hai.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb: 'Said to me' convert hokar 'told me' bana, conjunction 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Third Person Pronoun Rule: Quoted clause mein pronouns 'She' aur 'her' 3rd person hain. 3rd person pronouns mein NO PERSON CHANGE hota hai.
steps.step4_inflection: Tense Backshift: Reporting verb past hone ke karan Present Perfect 'has misplaced' Past Perfect 'had misplaced' mein shift ho gaya.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'Suresh told me that she had misplaced her court access badge.'

trapWarning: PRONOUN OVER-MODIFICATION: Candidates 3rd person pronouns 'she/her' ko listener 'me' ke hisaab se 'I/my' mein badalne ki galti karte hain. 3rd person pronouns hamesha unchanged rehte hain.

sentence: Direct: The senior clerk said, "I must submit the compliance report today."
correctAnswer: The senior clerk said that he had to submit the compliance report that day.

steps.step1_marker: Speaker Analysis: Speaker 'The senior clerk' (male singular) hai.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb & Conjunction: Past verb 'said' ke baad conjunction 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Pronoun Shift: 1st person 'I' clerk ke anusaar 'he' ban gaya.
steps.step4_inflection: Modal & Adverb Adjustment: Specific present/past obligation darshane wala modal 'must' past reporting context mein 'had to' mein badla. Time word 'today' 'that day' ban gaya.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'The senior clerk said that he had to submit the compliance report that day.'

trapWarning: MUST BACKSHIFT DISTINCTION: Agar option mein 'must' retain ho aur 'had to' wala valid option available ho, toh specific deadline/obligation ke liye 'had to' exam-preferred hota hai. Saath hi 'today' ko 'that day' check karein.

sentence: Direct: Amit said to Pooja, "I prepared the case summary, but the bench was not sitting."
correctAnswer: Amit told Pooja that he had prepared the case summary, but the bench had not been sitting.

steps.step1_marker: Speaker & Listener: Speaker Amit hai, listener Pooja hai. Sentence compound hai jisme 'but' se do coordinate clauses jude hain.
steps.step2_time: Reporting Verb: 'Said to Pooja' ➔ 'told Pooja' bana, conjunction 'that' lagaya.
steps.step3_aspect: Pronoun Reference: Clause 1 ka 1st person 'I' Amit ke anusaar 'he' ban gaya.
steps.step4_inflection: Dual Tense Backshift: Clause 1 mein Simple Past 'prepared' Past Perfect 'had prepared' bana. Clause 2 mein Past Continuous 'was not sitting' Past Perfect Continuous 'had not been sitting' bana.
steps.step5_synthesis: Final Synthesis: 'Amit told Pooja that he had prepared the case summary, but the bench had not been sitting.'

trapWarning: COMPOUND SENTENCE CONSISTENCY: Dono clauses past reporting verb ke under hain, isliye dono clauses mein coordinated backshift aana mandatory hai. Ek clause ko backshift karna aur dusre ko chhod dena common distractor hai.
